items.Sentence: 943 are conventional OWTS that consist of a septic tank followed by effluent dispersal to an individual or shared leachfield.
258 are non-conventional OWTS such as shallow trench pressure distributed systems, mound systems, at-grade systems, and aerobic treatment and filter pretreatment units.
